slowbro-offensive-tank-slowbro.label: Mega offensive tank
slowbro-offensive-tank-slowbro.description: Hits hard with Scald and Flamethrower from Mega Slowbro's huge Defense, and heals with Slack Off. Holds Slowbronite to Mega Evolve into Mega Slowbro in battle.

gardevoir-bulky-attacker.label: Mega bulky attacker
gardevoir-bulky-attacker.description: Fires Pixilate-boosted Hyper Voice and Taunts walls and setup. Holds Gardevoirite to Mega Evolve into Mega Gardevoir in battle.

altaria-special-attacker.label: Mega special attacker
altaria-special-attacker.description: Fires Pixilate-boosted Hyper Voice and Fire Blast, and heals with Roost. Holds Altarianite to Mega Evolve into Mega Altaria in battle.

altaria-support.label: Mega cleric
altaria-support.description: Heals the team's status with Heal Bell and itself with Roost. Holds Altarianite to Mega Evolve into Mega Altaria in battle.

charizard-bulky-will-o-wisp.label: Mega X Will-O-Wisp tank
charizard-bulky-will-o-wisp.description: Burns physical attackers with Will-O-Wisp and heals with Roost. Holds Charizardite X to Mega Evolve into Mega Charizard X in battle.

venusaur-offensive.label: Mega Growth attacker
venusaur-offensive.description: Boosts with Growth behind Mega Venusaur's bulk and heals with Synthesis. Holds Venusaurite to Mega Evolve into Mega Venusaur in battle.

venusaur-defensive.label: Mega tank
venusaur-defensive.description: Walls Fire, Water and Fighting attackers with Thick Fat and heals with Synthesis. Holds Venusaurite to Mega Evolve into Mega Venusaur in battle.

latias-defensive.label: Mega Thunder Wave support
latias-defensive.description: Paralyzes foes with Thunder Wave and heals with Recover. Holds Latiasite to Mega Evolve into Mega Latias in battle.

blissey-wish.label: Wish support
blissey-wish.description: Passes big Wishes to the team and wears foes down with Toxic and Seismic Toss.

hydreigon-expert-belt.label: Expert Belt attacker
hydreigon-expert-belt.description: Boosts its super-effective hits with Expert Belt and covers many foes with four attacking types.

cresselia-defensive.label: Lunar Dance support
cresselia-defensive.description: Paralyzes foes with Thunder Wave, then sacrifices itself with Lunar Dance to fully heal a teammate.

volcanion-bulky-offensive.label: Bulky attacker
volcanion-bulky-offensive.description: Hits hard with Steam Eruption and wide coverage while taking hits well.
